extracted.intended_audience: patent and trademark examiners, classification specialists, and IP professionals preparing or classifying figurative/graphical elements
extracted.subtask_description: Applying the Vienna Classification (5th ed.) rules to classify figurative elements, drawings and representations appearing in patent/trademark documents across categories such as tools, machinery, containers, transport, measurement instruments, arms, heraldry, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keys (division 14.5)
rubrics_metrics.description: Subcategories include one key; two keys; more than two keys; keys with bows of circular, oval or constricted oval shape; keys with lobed bows; keys with diamond-shaped bows, figured or otherwise, with straight or concave edge; flat keys; other keys; parts of keys.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reference to Principal Section 14.5.1. Use auxiliary section labelling where provided (A 14.5.x) to indicate specific key counts and bow shapes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tools (division 14.7)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal listings include hammers, sledge-hammers, mallets (14.7.1); axes (14.7.2); anvils, shoemakers' lasts (14.7.4); other tools (14.7.6); cutlery (14.7.18); bricklayers' trowels and plasterers' hawks, spatulas other than artists' palette knives (14.7.23).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: including handles; (a) not including agricultural or horticultural implements classified in division 14.9. Explicit auxiliary sections list crossed hammers/axes, tongs, tweezers, wedge keys, spanners, screwdrivers, braces, bow handles, hand drills, power drills, pneumatic hammers, bits, sharpening stones, saws and saw blades, knives, scissors, sheep shears. Follow auxiliary-section codes (A 14.7.x) for specific tool-grouping.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tools — exclusions and cross-references
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain implements are explicitly excluded from Tool divisions: e.g., agricultural/horticultural implements (division 14.9); open razors (10.5.4), table knives (11.1.1), daggers (23.1.1); sawtoothed wheels and disks of circular saws (15.7.1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When classifying, observe the cross-references and do not classify excluded items under 14.7; use the referenced division instead.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agricultural or horticultural implements, ice axes (division 14.9)
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes spades (14.9.1), pickaxes, ice axes, hoes (14.9.5), scythes, sickles (14.9.7), and other agricultural or horticultural implements (14.9.10).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections specify spade shapes (round/pointed vs rectangular/square) and list rakes, ploughs, ploughshares under auxiliary codes (A 14.9.11, A 14.9.13). Use these to refine classification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ladders (division 14.11)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal section 14.11.1: Ladders. Auxiliary sections: single ladders (A 14.11.2), double ladders (A 14.11.3), stepladders (A 14.11.4), swimming pool ladders (A 14.11.5).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Classify ladder designs using the principal or auxiliary section that best matches number of parts/format.

rubrics_metrics.name: Machines for industry or agriculture; industrial installations; motors and engines (division 15.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal sections include machines for industry and industrial installations (15.1.1 e.g., pressing, grinding, mixing, distilling, excavating including millstones); conveyor belts (15.1.7); motors, engines (15.1.11); propellers, ventilators, blowers, turbines, burners (15.1.13); parts of machines including robotic arms (15.1.17); cranes, blocks and tackle, pulleys (15.1.19); sprayers, paint sprayguns, fire extinguishers, water sprinklers (15.1.21); machines for agriculture (15.1.22); petrol pumps (15.1.23); automatic distributors, coin-freed vending machines (15.1.24); various other mechanical appliances including door closers (15.1.25).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: not including machines for household use and spinning wheels (15.3) or office machines (15.5). Tools for agriculture are classified in division 14.9. Not including power drills and pneumatic hammers (14.7.6). Use parts-of-machine entries (15.1.17) for component representations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Machines for household use; spinning wheels (division 15.3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal section 15.3.1: Machines for household use. Examples/auxiliary sections list sewing machines (A 15.3.3), vacuum cleaners and polishers (A 15.3.5), spinning wheels and looms (15.3.11), and other household machines (A 15.3.9).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes exclude kitchen machines (11.1.10), washing machines (13.3.23) and household drying equipment (13.3.24). Use auxiliary codes to place specific household machine types.

rubrics_metrics.name: Office machines (division 15.5)
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes typewriters (15.5.1) and other office machines (15.5.25).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: not including word processors (16.1.4). Use 16.1 for computers/word processors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wheels and bearings (division 15.7)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal sections include cog wheels and wheel cogs (15.7.1), ships' wheels, capstans, paddle wheels (15.7.7), other wheels with or without spokes (15.7.9), ball bearings and other bearings (15.7.11), gearing and transmission wheels (15.7.15), wheels or wheel segments with wings (15.7.17).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: not including tyred wheels and vehicle wheels mounted on axles (18.1.21). Auxiliary sections (A 15.7.x) classify sawtoothed wheels, segments, spokes, and whether wheels/bearings have inscriptions, human/animal/plant figurative elements, or other figurative elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electrical equipment (division 15.9)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal section 15.9.1: Electrical equipment. Auxiliary sections list batteries/piles (A 15.9.2), sparking plugs (A 15.9.3), electrical accessories for vehicles (A 15.9.9), electric plugs (A 15.9.10), switches (A 15.9.11), insulators (A 15.9.15), transistors/diodes/resistors/magnets (A 15.9.16), integrated circuits/computer chips (A 15.9.18), and other electrical apparatus (A 15.9.25).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: not including electric lamps and wireless valves (13.1.6) or electric cables (14.1.5). Use auxiliary codes to indicate specific electrical items or vehicle-related exceptions (headlamp exclusions noted).

rubrics_metrics.name: Telecommunications, sound recording or reproduction, computers (division 16.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal sections include aerials, satellite dishes, pylons, posts or lines for telephone or electricity (16.1.1) and telecommunication, television, sound recording or sound reproduction apparatus and equipment, computers (16.1.4). Auxiliary sections list radio/television apparatus, computers/word processors (A 16.1.5), computer mouses (A 16.1.6), keyboards (A 16.1.7/8), telephone receivers (A 16.1.11), fax machines, microphones, headphones, record players, discs for sound/image/data and their sleeves/boxes, recording tapes and cassettes (A 16.1.16-17, A 16.1.25).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: include apparatus for reproduction of images (video). Not including wireless valves (13.1.6). Use auxiliary entries for input/output devices and media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Photography, cinematography, optics (division 16.3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal section 16.3.1: Photographic or cinematographic apparatus, projection apparatus and lanterns (including video cameras and photographic lenses). Other apparatus include spectacles and frames (16.3.13), binoculars/telescopes/microscopes (16.3.15), magnifying glasses with handle (16.3.17), optical lenses/contact lenses/spectacle lenses (16.3.19), and other optical apparatus (16.3.25).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections (A 16.3.x) include iris diaphragms and films/containers for films (A 16.3.3, A 16.3.5). Use these to refine classification of camera/optical components.

rubrics_metrics.name: Horological instruments (division 17.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal section 17.1.1: Horological instruments. Includes sundials (17.1.17), sandglasses (17.1.19), clocks and alarm clocks (A 17.1.7), watches (A 17.1.16), watch bracelets (A 17.1.13), dials (circular or non-circular) and hands, and other parts of horological instruments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: dials of measuring instruments other than horological are classified in 17.5. Use auxiliary codes to indicate dial shape (A 17.1.2, A 17.1.3). Not including spiral springs (14.3.21).

rubrics_metrics.name: Jewelry (division 17.2)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal sections include precious stones (17.2.1), pearls (17.2.5), necklaces/bracelets/chains (17.2.13), rings and wedding rings (17.2.17), other jewels (17.2.25).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: includes cuff links, tie pins and hat pins. Auxiliary sections further specify precious stones cut in facets and other representations (A 17.2.2, A 17.2.4) and pearls or precious stones in an oyster (A 17.2.6).

rubrics_metrics.name: Balances and weights (division 17.3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal section 17.3.1: Balances, weights. Auxiliary sections list balances with two trays (A 17.3.2), other balances (A 17.3.3, A 17.3.5), parts of balances (A 17.3.11), and weights.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use auxiliary codes for specific balance configurations and parts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Measures and measuring instruments (division 17.5)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal section 17.5.1: Measures (including calculating instruments). Auxiliary sections include instruments for linear measurement (yardsticks, graduated rulers, tape measures, surveyors' tapes and chains), slide rules, calculating disks and cylinders, abacuses (A 17.5.2), gauges, calipers, vernier gauges, micrometers (A 17.5.5), plumb lines and lead weights (A 17.5.13), levels (A 17.5.15), dials of measuring instruments (A 17.5.17), compasses for draftsmen, squares, French curves, T-squares (A 17.5.19), thermometers (A 17.5.19?), compasses, mariners' compasses (A 17.5.21), and other measuring instruments and markers (A 17.5.25).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: include calculating instruments; do not classify time-measuring instruments here (they belong in 17.1) and do not include compass cards (1.1.17). Use auxiliary section codes for granular types.

rubrics_metrics.name: Land vehicles (division 18.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal sections include vehicles propelled by human or animal power (18.1.1), bicycles/motor cycles/motor scooters/tricycles (18.1.5), motor road vehicles (18.1.7), rail vehicles/trains/tramcars (18.1.11), other land vehicles (18.1.14). Auxiliary sections list chariots, horse-drawn carriages, motor cars, lorries, coaches, tractors, locomotives, road rollers, lifts, toboggans, caravans, perambulators, scooters, supermarket trolleys, wheelchairs (A 18.1.x).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: includes tyres, tyre prints, snow chains, axles with or without wheels, steering wheels, radiators, exhausts, shock absorbers of land vehicles (18.1.21) — also parts not classified elsewhere. Exclusions: escalators (7.3.15) and conveyor belts (15.1.7). Use auxiliary codes to indicate specific vehicle subtypes and stylized representations (A 18.1.23 etc).

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment for animals (division 18.2)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal entries include horseshoes (18.2.1 — note: including horseshoe-shaped magnets), equipment for horses (18.2.7), equipment for dogs and cats (18.2.17), equipment for other animals (18.2.25). Auxiliary sections include stirrups/spurs (A 18.2.9), harness (A 18.2.11), saddles (A 18.2.13), whips/hunting crops (A 18.2.15), collars and leashes for dogs and cats (A 18.2.18).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the listed auxiliary sections to classify specific animal equipment; observe the special inclusions (e.g., decorative or magnet-shaped horseshoes).

rubrics_metrics.name: Vehicles for use on water and amphibious vehicles (division 18.3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal sections include rowing boats/canoes/gondolas/dinghies/kayaks (18.3.1), sailing boats/sailboards (18.3.2), motor boats and ships (18.3.14), sails (18.3.21), and other means of transport on water (18.3.25). Auxiliary sections list Viking boats, ancient sailing boats, large sailing boats, other sailing boats, sailboards/surfboards, mixed ships (sail and steam), liners (A 18.3.x), submarines (A 18.3.16), trawlers/tugs (A 18.3.17), ships' funnels (A 18.3.18).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: includes any other parts of boats not classified elsewhere; amphibious vehicles and air-cushion vehicles are included in 18.3. Use auxiliary codes to indicate historical or stylized boat depictions and parts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Anchors; buoys or lifebelts (division 18.4)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal section 18.4.1: Anchors; buoys or lifebelts. Auxiliary sections include anchors, crossed anchors (A 18.4.2–3, A 18.4.11) and buoys or lifebelts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use auxiliary codes for representation counts (crossed anchors) and related elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Aerial or space vehicles (division 18.5)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal sections list aeroplanes and helicopters (18.5.1), other aerial vehicles (18.5.5), and space rockets/capsules/artificial satellites (18.5.10). Auxiliary sections include stylized aeroplanes (A 18.5.3), balloons/dirigible balloons (A 18.5.6), kites/delta-wing gliders (A 18.5.7), parachutes (A 18.5.8).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use principal vs auxiliary codes to distinguish type and stylization; include space vehicles under 18.5.10.

rubrics_metrics.name: Traffic signs and indicator boards (division 18.7)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal sections include road or railway traffic signs (18.7.1) and water or air traffic signs (18.7.22). Auxiliary sections include direction indicator boards or posts, street name/number plates, road or railway traffic lights (A 18.7.9, A 18.7.11), milestones (A 18.7.13), other road/railway traffic signs (A 18.7.20), semaphores (A 18.7.19), signal buoys and other water/air traffic signs (A 18.7.23, A 18.7.25).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Classify signage according to medium (road/rail vs water/air) and auxiliary typology (lights, milestones, posts).

rubrics_metrics.name: Large containers (division 19.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal sections include large cylindrical or elliptical containers (tanks, gas bottles, barrels) (19.1.1), large non-cylindrical or non-elliptical containers (packing cases, crates, skips) (19.1.3), tins and cans, pails, watering cans (19.1.4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: not including containers classified in 19.9; auxiliary sections specify barrel orientations, vats, wooden buckets, milking pails, large sacks for transporting merchandise, baskets, portable bottle crates, and other large containers (A 19.1.x).

rubrics_metrics.name: Small containers (division 19.3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal sections include small cylindrical or elliptical containers (tubes for pills/lipsticks, pots for cosmetic cream, preserve tins, jars, cans) (19.3.1) and small non-cylindrical or non-elliptical containers (19.3.3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections include letter boxes, sachets (A 19.3.4/5), small open containers (A 19.3.9), tubes or bottles with wrappers (A 19.3.15), tubes pinched at one end (A 19.3.21), paper/card prepared for assembling into small containers (A 19.3.24). Observe explicit exclusions (not including containers in 11.3, 19.7, 19.9 or 19.11).

rubrics_metrics.name: Bottles and flasks (division 19.7)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal sections classify bottles or flasks by cross-section and shape: circular/elliptical horizontal cross section (19.7.1), other horizontal cross sections (19.7.2), bottles representing a human/animal/body part or inanimate object (19.7.6), bottles with handle (19.7.7), feeding bottles (19.7.26), and other bottles or flasks (19.7.25).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections (A 19.7.x) further refine slender, squat, without neck, sloping or horizontal neck, inward-curving sides, bulging/protruding/rounded sides, conical shape, ribs, surface relief, wicker casing. Use auxiliary codes to indicate these shape attributes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Parts or accessories of bottles (division 19.8)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal section 19.8.1: Parts or accessories of bottles. Auxiliary listings include bottle necks (A 19.8.2), stoppers/corks (A 19.8.5), sealing capsules (A 19.8.7), other parts or accessories of bottles (A 19.8.25).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: includes pouring devices and teats for babies' bottles; not including bottle openers and corkscrews (11.1.10). Use auxiliary entries to represent specific accessories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amphorae, pitchers, vases, flower pots and stands (division 19.9)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal section 19.9.1: Amphorae, pitchers, vases, flower pots, flower stands. Auxiliary sections include amphorae with or without handles/pitchers (A 19.9.2), flower vases/decorative vases (A 19.9.3), flower pots or plant-growing pots (A 19.9.7), flower stands/plant boxes (A 19.9.9).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use auxiliary coding for handle presence and functional subtypes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Receptacles for laboratory use and for pharmacy (division 19.11)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal sections include mortars (19.11.1) and receptacles for laboratory use and for pharmacy (19.11.4). Auxiliary sections list retorts (spherical/ovoid), triangular retorts, balloon flasks, test tubes and other lab receptacles (A 19.11.5–A 19.11.13, A 19.11.25).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: includes mortars for kitchen use; use auxiliary entries to indicate shape-specific receptacles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Medical or surgical apparatus, instruments or utensils; prostheses; medicines (division 19.13)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal section 19.13.1: Medical or surgical apparatus, instruments or utensils, prostheses, medicines. Auxiliary sections include hypodermic syringes (A 19.13.3), massage apparatus (A 19.13.5), prostheses (A 19.13.7), condoms (A 19.13.13), plasters and bandages (A 19.13.15), phials/capsules/pills/tablets/suppositories (A 19.13.21), stethoscopes (A 19.13.22), and other medical apparatus (A 19.13.25).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use auxiliary codes to indicate particular medical devices or consumables; classify medicines and prostheses under this division.

rubrics_metrics.name: Representations of miscellaneous products (division 19.19)
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes representations of products not classified in other categories, divisions and sections (e.g., coal, coke, briquettes).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this division for product representations that do not fit elsewhere.

rubrics_metrics.name: Writing, drawing or painting materials; small office requisites (division 20.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal section 20.1.1: Writing, drawing or painting materials including artists' palette knives (except 20.1.15 and 20.1.17). Other entries include artists' easels, drawing boards, blackboards, slates (20.1.15) and other small office requisites (20.1.17).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: includes paper clips, pencil sharpeners, adhesive tape dispensers, inking pads, toner cartridges. Not including drawing pins (14.3.1) and office requisites classified in 17.5.1 and 20.5. Use auxiliary sections (A 20.1.x) to list pencils/pens/pens nibs, paint brushes, rollers, clapperboards (A 20.1.16), embossed stamps (A 20.1.19).

rubrics_metrics.name: Papers and documents (division 20.5)
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes parchments with furled or fringed edges (20.5.1), other documents bearing handwritten or printed texts or tables (20.5.5), plans/schematic drawings/diagrams/curves/outlines (20.5.7), cards/card indexes/punched cards or tapes (20.5.11), envelopes (20.5.13), visiting cards (20.5.14), tie-on labels (20.5.15), bank/credit/ID cards (20.5.16), postage stamps (20.5.21), bank notes (20.5.23), paper in rolls/wallpaper/other papers and documents (20.5.25).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the listed subcategories to classify different document types and printed matter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Books, bookbindings, newspapers (division 20.7)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal section 20.7.1: Books, magazines, newspapers, bookbindings, binders. Auxiliary sections include books/magazines/newspapers (A 20.7.2), bookbindings/binders (A 20.7.5), and headings of newspapers or magazines (A 20.7.7).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Classify printed periodical formats and bindings with appropriate auxiliary codes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Games and toys (division 21.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal section 21.1.1: Packs of cards, playing cards, figures on playing cards. Other entries include playing dice, dominoes (21.1.9), draughtboards, chessboards, chessmen (21.1.11–13), puzzles and constituent elements (21.1.14), building games (21.1.15), balloons (21.1.16), wind mills (21.1.17), and other games or toys (21.1.25).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes and auxiliaries specify suit symbols, figure depictions, and pack configurations (A 21.1.x). Use these to classify card and board game pictorial elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sporting articles and roundabouts (division 21.3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes footballs and other balls, shuttlecocks, skittles, rackets (21.3.1–3), golf clubs and hockey sticks (21.3.7), snowboards (21.3.10), ice or roller skates, skateboards (21.3.11), skis/ski sticks (21.3.13), dumb-bells/weights for lifting (21.3.13–15), tackle for fishing and hunting (21.3.15), nets for fishing/hunting/games (21.3.16), goals for football and team sports (21.3.17), roundabouts/chutes/swings/seesaws (21.3.19), targets (21.3.21), boxing gloves (21.3.23), other sporting articles (21.3.25).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: includes gymnastic apparatus and instruments; not including ice-axes (14.9.5), bows/arrows/javelins (classified elsewhere). Use auxiliary codes for particular sporting equipment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Musical instruments and accessories; bells; pictures and sculptures (division 22)
rubrics_metrics.description: Musical instruments (22.1) list percussion instruments, wind instruments/whistles (22.1.5), keyboard instruments (22.1.10), stringed instruments (22.1.15), musical instrument accessories and music accessories (22.1.21). Bells (22.3.1) list one, two, three, more than three bells and small globular bells. Pictures and sculptures (22.5.1) include pictures, sculptures representing human beings (22.5.10), animals (22.5.19), other sculptures including abstract sculpture and famous pictures, equestrian sculptures and subtypes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary entries further refine instrument families (brass, woodwind, pipe organs), accessories (drumsticks, bows, tuning forks, metronomes, stands, cases), and sculpture subject-matter (woman/man/child/group/equestrian). Use exact auxiliary codes to denote subtype and subject.

rubrics_metrics.name: Arms, ammunition, armour (division 23)
rubrics_metrics.description: Side arms and other weapons (23.1) include side arms, spears, swords, daggers (23.1.1), bows, quivers (23.1.5), crossbows (23.1.7), other weapons (23.1.25). Firearms, ammunition, explosives (23.3) include firearms (23.3.1) and ammunition/explosives (23.3.10) with auxiliaries for cannons, rifles, pistols and ammunition types (lead-shot cartridges, ball cartridges, shells, rockets, grenades). Armour (23.5) lists armour (23.5.1) and parts including helmets (A 23.5.x).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: not including military tanks, aircraft or warships (classified in 18.x). Use auxiliary codes to indicate counts and specific weapon subfamilies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Heraldry, coins, emblems, symbols (division 24)
rubrics_metrics.description: Shields (24.1) include shields with neither figurative element nor inscription (24.1.1), shields with geometrical figures or partitions (24.1.3), shields with figurative elements or inscriptions placed outside (24.1.5/17), several shields (24.1.23), shields of unusual shape (24.1.25). Seals/stamps (24.3) include seals attached/applied to a document or object, circular/elliptical/other forms and subtypes showing heavenly bodies, human beings, animals, plants, landscapes, manufactured articles, geometrical figures, inscriptions or other figurative elements. Medals/coins/decorations (24.5) include one medal or coin (24.5.1), two or more, decorations/orders (24.5.20) and auxiliaries for representation of human head. Flags (24.7) include one flag (24.7.1), two or more flags (24.7.3) and auxiliaries for clusters, banderoles, several flags on same staff, shaped tips, triangular flags, stylized flags. Crowns/diadems (24.9) include crowns closed at top (24.9.1), crowns open at top (24.9.2) and stylized or fanciful crowns (24.9.3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections specify representations placed on/around shields and stamps (heavenly bodies, human figures, animals, plants, buildings, industrial articles, inscriptions). Use these granular auxiliaries to classify heraldic and emblematic representations accurately.
